About MASLOC

Building a Stronger Foundation for Ghanaian Enterprise

The Microfinance and Small Loans Centre is the Government of Ghana institution dedicated to accessible microfinance for individuals and small businesses — the apex body of Ghana's microfinance sub-sector.

Established in 2006, MASLOC has provided microcredit and small loans to start-ups and small businesses with fast, easy and accessible financing to grow and expand their operations across Ghana.

Discover Our Mandate

Loan Services

Financing Built for How Ghana Works

From market trader collectives to agribusinesses and transport entrepreneurs — MASLOC services meet businesses where they are.

Microcredit & Group Loans

Microcredit for groups, associations and cooperatives with a common production or operational interest — MASLOC's founding service for community enterprise.

View Microcredit

Small & Project Loans

Financing for individuals, businesses and joint ventures with an ongoing business or a viable, employment-generating project.

View Small & Project Loans

Vehicle & Equipment Hire Purchase

A hire purchase scheme enabling drivers and working entrepreneurs to own the vehicles and equipment central to their livelihoods.

View Hire Purchase

Wholesale Lending & Microfinance Support

Wholesale lending to microfinance institutions for on-lending to small businesses, alongside institutional support for the microfinance sub-sector.

View Wholesale Lending

For Applicants

How to Apply with MASLOC

Straightforward steps, published criteria and an office near you. No guesswork — and no invented requirements.

  1. 1

    Review the criteria

    Check the published eligibility for each MASLOC service — age, group size and business requirements.

  2. 2

    Prepare your venture

    Groups of 5–25 with leaders and rules; individuals with an ongoing or viable start-up business.

  3. 3

    Visit a MASLOC office

    Full eligibility criteria and application guidance are available at every regional office and the Head Office.

  4. 4

    Apply on site

    Staff confirm documents, current terms and processing expectations for your facility.
